answer: Each epoch an agent must hold fresh ivory from every walnut, and each walnut prices its own epoch's mint in rungs: the n-th piece it mints that epoch burns n×base jade. An operator running k clones must buy k ivory from every walnut every epoch, climbing every ladder in full — the clones together burn C×k(k+1)/2×base jade per epoch, recurring, unparallelizable because each ladder counts only that walnut's own epoch and no clone may skip a walnut. A newcomer buys the first ivory at base.
